These fixtures contain synthetic values only. They are shaped from the official
Transmission 4.1.3 RPC contract and the current Sonarr/Radarr API v3 queue
contracts; they contain no captured service responses or credentials.

- Transmission contract: https://github.com/transmission/transmission/blob/4.1.3/docs/rpc-spec.md
- Sonarr queue v3: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/v5-develop/src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Queue/QueueController.cs
- Sonarr paging: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/v5-develop/src/Sonarr.Http/PagingResource.cs
- Radarr queue v3: https://github.com/Radarr/Radarr/blob/develop/src/Radarr.Api.V3/Queue/QueueController.cs
- Radarr paging: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Radarr/Radarr/develop/src/Radarr.Http/PagingResource.cs
